_about: Temperament fragment (List 12 #108) — the mechanical layer derived from #80's personality_seed. ONE seed: this block is a second derivation beside #80's variance and temperament_read, never a separate roll. Cells are keyed by (favours, hinders) stat pair so display names can attach later under the rename law without touching data. All values OPEN.

carePreference._about: The native equivalent of the reference flavour pair, expressed in #39's care families read through #28's care axes.
carePreference.effectStrengthStatus: OPEN — presentation/behaviour use is specified in the spec; any numeric effect on #39 accrual is a proposed, unruled interface
carePreference.resists: <care family this individual takes to least readily>
carePreference.responds: <care family this individual takes to most readily>

grid._shape: 25 cells: every (favours, hinders) pair over statKeys; favours == hinders is the neutral diagonal (no modifier).

cellShape.displayNameStatus: OPEN — temperament naming is an owner naming pass (rename law, #23 lookups)

growthModifierStatus: OPEN — reference documentation uses ±10%; Mochiichao's value is an owner balance pass and is NOT asserted here
statKeysNote: hp excluded from the grid per the documented reference pattern — an architecture choice, stated as such, not a canon fact.
